def solve(G, insadj=8):
    G=np.array(G); H,W=G.shape
    out=G.copy()
    lab,n = ndimage.label(G==1)
    ones = G==1
    # global background connectivity to border
    blab,bn = ndimage.label(G==0)
    border_labels = set(blab[0,:])|set(blab[-1,:])|set(blab[:,0])|set(blab[:,-1])
    dil = ndimage.binary_dilation(ones, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        comp = (lab==i)
        if not comp.any(): continue
        ys,xs = np.where(comp)
        r0,r1,c0,c1 = ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
        # enclosed background cells of this component: zeros within bbox not connected to border
        enclosed = np.zeros((H,W),bool)
        for a in range(r0,r1+1):
            for b in range(c0,c1+1):
                if G[a,b]==0 and blab[a,b] not in border_labels:
                    enclosed[a,b]=True
        if not enclosed.any():
            continue  # open shape or pixel: unchanged
        # paint: dilation cells
        for a in range(max(0,r0-1), min(H,r1+2)):
            for b in range(max(0,c0-1), min(W,c1+2)):
                if G[a,b]==1 or not dil[a,b] or not comp.any(): pass
                if G[a,b]!=0: continue
                # is this cell within 1 of THIS component?
                near = False
                for dy in (-1,0,1):
                    for dx in (-1,0,1):
                        y2,x2=a+dy,b+dx
                        if 0<=y2<H and 0<=x2<W and comp[y2,x2]: near=True
                if not near: continue
                if enclosed[a,b]:
                    if insadj==8:
                        adj=any(0<=a+dy<H and 0<=b+dx<W and comp[a+dy,b+dx] for dy in (-1,0,1) for dx in (-1,0,1) if (dy,dx)!=(0,0))
                    else:
                        adj=any(0<=a+dy<H and 0<=b+dx<W and comp[a+dy,b+dx] for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)))
                    out[a,b]=3 if adj else 0
                else:
                    out[a,b]=2
    return out

                if not near: continue
